description: As part of the weekend event Build /  Play / Shape Croydon, MATT+FIONA will lead a collaborative cardboard-build activity inspired by landmarks from Croydon's skyline. Visitors of all ages can help create a large scale installation using pre-made silhouette templates and recycled materials, contributing to "Croydon of the Future, Drawing on the Past".

factsheet.heading: MATT + FIONA: Croydon Skyline
paragraphs: Join MATT + FIONA to help shape a growing cardboard skyline inspired by Croydon’s heritage and future possibilities. Using large-scale giant cut-out landmarks, visitors can contribute to an evolving installation across The Queen’s Gardens. Upcycle materials to invent new spaces and structures, imagining what Croydon could become. Through building Croydon’s skyline, MATT + FIONA encourage young people to think critically about the places around them and turn ideas into action through building, learning and connection.

factsheet.heading: Build / Play / Shape Croydon
paragraphs:
This activity is part of Build / Play / Shape Croydon. Launch into a weekend of design-inspired creativity and play for all ages, 12-13 September. 
Find out more here: www.culturecroydon.com
